# scripts/ops/Set-AvdSpendBudget.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Creates or updates a sandbox subscription's standing cost budget, named sandbox-spend, so Azure emails you even when no landing zone is deployed (docs/sandbox-runs.md).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-Amount` | double | yes |  |  |

| `-SubscriptionId` | string | no |  |  |
| `-Name` | string | no | `'sandbox-spend'` |  |
